statements.impact_statement: govulncheck v1.6.0 binary-mode analysis found no affected os.Root symbols in the Alertmanager v0.33.1 binary, and the deployed configuration does not accept filesystem paths from alert data.
statements.action_statement: Keep configuration and data mounts read-only where possible and remove this statement when an upstream Alertmanager release built with Go 1.26.5 or newer is pinned.

statements.impact_statement: govulncheck v1.6.0 found no affected SSH symbols in the Alertmanager v0.33.1 binary; TSX Core configures webhook delivery only and enables no SSH server, client, certificate, agent, or known-hosts path.
statements.action_statement: Retain the webhook-only notifier contract and remove this statement when an upstream release built with golang.org/x/crypto v0.52.0 or newer is pinned.

statements.impact_statement: govulncheck v1.6.0 binary-mode analysis found no affected gRPC symbols in the Alertmanager v0.33.1 binary; the service exposes HTTP only and configures neither a gRPC server nor xDS RBAC.
statements.action_statement: Keep the service bound to host loopback, retain CPU and memory limits, and remove this statement when an upstream release built with google.golang.org/grpc v1.82.1 or newer is pinned.
